summary: WP-ESC-007 adds an opt-in, authenticated, read-only Estate facade with fail-closed behavior throughout. SCP_ESTATE_READ_ONLY_ENABLED defaults false; a typo'd flag fails REST startup rather than silently enabling. When enabled, ServiceConfig.validate() enforces AUTH_ENABLED=true, no legacy bearer, CT_APP_ID=scp, pinned CT_ISSUER. Every /registry, /consult, /audit request passes CT-SDK signature/expiry/audience validation then exact _estate_claims_match (iss/aud-singleton/sub/azp/actor_type/scopes/org binding). The MCP estate profile registers exactly the six read tools and excludes propose (writes proposal files) and audit_changed (shells to git, caller repo_root). Health is truthful (degraded on missing artifacts). No correctness blocker.

findings.summary: CLI _estate_feature_enabled treats any non-{1,true,yes,on} value as False (silently refuses estate profile) while service _coerce_feature_flag raises on out-of-vocabulary values; both fail-closed but diverge on diagnostics.
findings.disposition: NOT_APPLICABLE (both directions fail-closed; the facade stays off either way). Recorded as a tracked diagnostic-consistency follow-up; not a security or correctness defect.

findings.disposition: NOT_APPLICABLE - as designed per WP-ESC-007 section 4 (invalid config fails startup; health derives from committed artifacts + config). C-ESC-006 satisfied; no signature/verification over-claim.
